To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) The Aichi Targets and SDGs include a wide variety of ecosystem services; (2) There are a wide variety of indicators available for monitoring progress towards the Aichi Targets; (3) There is a wide variety of monitoring information available from national ecosystem assessments for monitoring progress towards SDGs; and (4) The monitoring information available from both sources is biased towards supply aspects of ecosystem services and lacks information on social behaviour and demand.
